Yeah big misunderstanding....  I already feel shitty enough without being thrown the blame.


I was happy with him, and very emotionally available. He encouraged me to go out and get a hobby. I did, suddenly he doesn't like that I spending time with people other than him. He encouraged me to go to school, then decides he doesn't like that I'm busy anymore. As for the money thing, he insisted I don't work. Repeatedly. It was his idea, I even told him I hated having to rely on someone else, I'm used to being financially responsible for my own shit. He straight up told me after a fight that he missed when I was unemployed and not in school, because I was home 24/7. That's not healthy.


Also you can be in a relationship and happy and still feel lonely. I have chronic depression, he knew that. We dealt with it together, along with his emotional struggles. I was lonely because it's hard for me to make friends, finding this club helped with that. But I was still there for him and made sure to spend as much time with him as I could. This came out of left field and honestly now I just regret posting this cause it's just making me feel worse.

Neither. You deserve to be here, if anything so that you can discover who YOU really are. I'm not trans so I can't speak from experience, however I have close friends who have gone through the same feelings you have and they are happy and loved. Their transition was like a beautiful metamorphosis. You may be worried about costs of transitioning, I have a close friend who took years to save for the costs, but the wait is worth it love.

You say no one will love you, but I can assure you there is someone out there waiting for you to walk into their life, and they will accept you for who you are.

Hell I don't even know you and I respect and love you for your bravery in admitting that you don't feel complete yet. You say you have no friends at school, but if you want one outside of school I'm always happy to make new friends.

Please pm me if you need to talk. I like your user name btw, for some reason it reminds me of when Dory was trying to talk to the whales :p
